summary: Learn data profiling, quality rules, defect remediation, and scorecard design. Explore the 5-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: Data quality management helps data stewards, analysts, and operational leads assess and improve the records their teams rely on. Participants practise profiling data in Excel against key quality dimensions, setting measurable rules and ownership, tracing defects to causes, and reporting trends through scorecards and improvement plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who define, maintain, analyse, or rely on organizational data and need practical methods to identify and reduce defects.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational data, such as customer, supplier, finance, or operational records, is useful. No programming or coding is required. Bring access to Excel for spreadsheet exercises; no specific data platform experience is expected.
